name: Rugosuchus
sum: Rugosuchus is a neosuchian crocodyliform with a wrinkled upper jaw from the Cretaceous Nenjiang Formation of China.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Most of a skull and mandible (per English Wikipedia).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Wu et al. 2001
